causal-factors.rationale: S&P Global notes that reorganizations dominated 2024 US bankruptcy filings, signaling a restructure-friendly environment rather than widespread liquidations, which modestly lowers the baseline odds of a Chapter 7-style bankruptcy for Frontier (source: S&P Global, January 2025).

synthesis: The objections reveal plausible liquidity and regulatory risks that the baseline 3% did not fully capture. Accounting for debt maturities, Z-score distress, and merger uncertainty, a calibrated probability around 12% with a plausible range 8-20% is warranted.
